steps.title: Define Photo Editor Pro project structure
steps.description: Initialize target environment variables matching Gradle 8.5 and Android SDK version 34.

steps.title: Create project Gradle build configurations
steps.description: Formulate build.gradle declaring exact namespace compatibility and dependencies matching environment guidelines.

steps.title: Formulate App Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate activity declarations, namespace specifications, and required storage permissions.

steps.title: Establish global dark styling definitions
steps.description: Declare primary dark UI color configurations and app metadata string tags.

steps.title: Construct layout XML boundaries
steps.description: Design an interactive, professional dark theme photo editing layout using relative constraints, top bar control panels, and a bottom horizontal tools layout.

steps.title: Create PhotoEditView rendering canvas
steps.description: Develop a custom view component to support complex high-performance image scaling, matrix transformations, and touch coordinate mapping.

steps.title: Implement multi-layer filter matrices
steps.description: Integrate real-time, non-destructive combination algorithms of ColorMatrix operations for brightness, contrast, grayscale, sepia, invert, lomo, warm, and cool presets.

steps.title: Develop stroke action recording mechanisms
steps.description: Code local custom drawing stroke layer objects supporting dynamic paint colors, custom stroke thicknesses, and interactive undo/redo capabilities.

steps.title: Program MainActivity controller bindings
steps.description: Bind top and bottom menu tabs, build native procedural demo image options, and implement interactive seekbar listeners.

steps.title: Integrate MediaStore saving routines
steps.description: Configure robust storage exports using modern scoped MediaStore APIs for older and newer devices alike.

steps.title: Building Photo Editor Pro
steps.description: Execute validation and final compilation of all project assets using Java 8 compatible native Android SDK methods.
